launches.title: Avocado 🥑 Restaurant POS with a built-in AI agent
launches.tagline: Run your restaurant with an AI agent that updates your menu, prices, and more
launches.body:
## **🚀 We’re launching Avocado – Restaurant POS with a built-in AI agent**

👋 Hi YC! We’re Nick Evans and Shayan Guha, co-founders of **Avocado** - a point-of-sale system for restaurants that now includes a **fully integrated AI assistant**. We’re thrilled to share our biggest update yet.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/ce5f4736-b005-49ce-b579-8bf8596ce1e8)

---

## **🧠 The problem: running a restaurant is overwhelming**

Independent restaurant owners juggle dozens of tools, dozens of vendors, and constant interruptions - all while trying to serve food and keep customers happy. Managing the POS, updating menus, pulling sales reports, figuring out Instagram posts, dealing with changing prices… it’s a full-time job _on top of_ their actual full-time job.

But the real bottleneck? **Information is trapped in systems that don’t talk to each other**, and most POS systems are clunky, hard to use, or just dumb.

---

## **🍳 The solution: an AI agent that _knows_ your restaurant**

Avocado is a POS system designed from the ground up to work with an AI assistant. Our agent understands your menu, your modifiers, your sales data, your customers, your staff - and it can take action across the system in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/4f4d0889-0077-48bd-a427-72d160f30492)

You can ask it:

* “Add a matcha latte to the menu for $5.50”
* “What’s my best-selling item on weekends?”
* “Update all egg-based items to reflect the new cost of eggs”
* “Create a social media post featuring today’s specials”
* “Tell me which servers had the highest tips last week”

…and it just **does it**. Right away. No UI to navigate, no learning curve, no training required.

💡 This is more than a chatbot. This is a **restaurant-native AI agent** with full control over the POS, KDS, kiosk, and online ordering systems - like having a superpowered GM in your pocket.

---

# **Check out our launch video here**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2QaQdDJlb0

---

# **✨ Here are some examples from the video:**

**Prompt** “Add a matcha latte to the menu”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/f4589fd7-69da-40c2-8d3f-a16fd766dbad)

**Prompt** “Write an Instagram post announcing our new matcha lattes”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/3e7c0988-ed76-486c-b3e0-e96ecb21629f)

**Prompt** “Raise all the prices of my egg dishes by 10%, round to the nearest quarter”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/0bfaae04-2776-442b-b3ba-3679ecedf2c7)

**Prompt** “We’re out of bacon. Mark everything with bacon as out of stock.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/2f4ec1fd-7ff8-4720-bce0-753093934587)

\
**👩‍🍳 Why we built Avocado**

We’ve worked with restaurants for years and have seen the same story over and over: people want to focus on hospitality and food - not software. But they were stuck with outdated POS systems or janky integrations between too many tools.

So we built Avocado to be the _last_ system a restaurant needs - tightly integrated hardware + software, a beautiful POS UI, and now, a deeply capable AI agent.\
(Also, we were frustrated that nobody else had done it right. So we did.)

---

## **📣 Call to action**

We're looking to work with independent restaurants, food trucks, cafes, and anyone tired of using 5 different tools to run their shop. If you want to try Avocado or just want to chat about what we’re building:

📬 Email us: [founders@avocadopos.com](mailto:founders@avocadopos.com)\
📱 Text us: (512) 580-7988\
🌐 Website:[ https://avocadopos.com](https://avocadopos.com)

---

## **🙏 Asks**

* If you know restaurant owners - especially in Texas or California - please send them our way.
* We’d love feedback on the demo and ideas for what the AI agent should do next.

Thanks YC - can’t wait to hear what you think.\
**Nick & Shayan**

launches.title: 🤖 🌮 OfOne - Automating order taking at fast food drive-thrus
launches.tagline: We help fast food restaurants improve operating margins by automating order taking at the drive-thru.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** OfOne is building software to automate order taking at fast-food drive-thrus. Using LLMs, we can save the typical restaurant owner $60,000 in labor costs per store annually.

Hi YC community - Adam Proschek (right) and Will Edwards (center) here - founders of [OfOne](https://www.of.one/). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69517&key=user_uploads/1162985/20300ff2-47c3-4229-83f1-f4987fe5ffd1)

### **The Problem:**

Quick-service restaurants are a $300B industry in the United States, comprising roughly 300,000 individual restaurant units. These businesses are low-margin with food & labor costs making up \~70% of OPEX. In recent years, operators (many of whom are immigrants and small business owners) have been getting squeezed as inflation and wages rise and labor becomes more scarce.

### **The Solution:**

OfOne is helping fast food operators make more money by automating their largest ordering channel: the drive-thru.

There are 200,000 drive-thrus in the United States and in many cases they contribute 70%+ of order volume. They are also expensive, costing on average $14.00 per hour to staff and operating for 12 hours per day - representing $12B in aggregate labor costs.

We’re offsetting these labor costs by automating the end-to-end ordering process - from greeting customers to answering questions to processing orders through the point-of-sale. Plus, it works with existing drive-thru audio systems.

Additionally, OfOne can intelligently upsell - like suggesting ice cream on a hot day - and always says please and thank you, raising average order size and improving customer experience.

We currently have signed & deployed pilots at major national chain stores.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69517&key=user_uploads/1162985/7d2fbb4f-dcc7-456f-b7d4-d5dcd518392a)

### **Why we’re building OfOne:**

We both know the quick-service industry well from building Crew (acq. by Square in 2021), which sold employee communication software to QSR brands, like Taco Bell.

Through this experience, we built valuable industry relationships and more importantly gained an in-depth understanding of how critical controlling labor costs is for restaurant success. Frankly, it can be the difference between a growing business and defaulting on interest payments for a personally guaranteed loan.

### **Our Ask:**

If you have any connections with **franchisees**, **multi-unit restaurant operators**, or **leaders at corporate brands** (e.g., Taco Bell Corporate), we’d love to speak with them and share how we can help!

_Here’s a quick blurb you can copy and paste_: A team of restaurant tech entrepreneurs recently launched an AI-powered order taker for quick-service restaurant drive-thrus. They are helping operators boost margins by reducing labor costs and increasing order sizes. You can contact [will@of.one](mailto:will@of.one) for more information.

If easier, I can also craft an easily forwardable email for you. Just reach out and let me know 😊.

launches.tagline: Meet Chow Central, building Chipotle of Africa!
launches.body:
Hi YC 👋🏾, we’re Tosin, Christopher, and Adeyemi operating from Lagos, Nigeria.

Chow Central is building restaurant chains for Millennials and Gen Z living in African cities who want high-quality and healthy meals. Think of us as Chipotle for African meals. 

Chow Central started as a fun experiment shortly after we graduated from University.  We created a virtual restaurant page on Twitter to sell affordable meals and also help underutilized restaurants get sales during the Covid lockdown.

We relaunched 18 months ago, currently active in just one region and we are doing over $80,000 in monthly revenue.

We have modified our approach, we operate a central kitchen to improve quality and maintain consistency. We then partner with highly-vetted underutilized commercial kitchens to serve as our fulfillment centers. 

Our customers love our delicious recipes and our faster & cheaper deliveries. Our approach of leveraging underutilized kitchens allows us to initially launch in a location with minimal capital investment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73617&key=user_uploads/902934/4b087e33-4f96-45e7-adf8-2811c6cd3e8b)

\
We operate two restaurant brands:

Firstly, 500chow is a high-quality restaurant that serves delicious local African delicacies. Our second restaurant is a healthy grill, shawarma, and barbecue restaurant.

Millennials and Gen Z in African cities who want to order meals online are still underserved. There are over 50 million of them, if we can serve 5 million of them once every month with an average spend of $8, this represents a $5B market opportunity. \
\
Chris and Yemi previously built industry-leading products at Moniepoint. Tosin previously worked at Vendease (W21) a restaurant supply-chain company.\
\
**How can you help?** 

* Refer us to your friends visiting or living in Lagos, Nigeria
* [Check out our newly released mobile application](https://chowcentral.onelink.me/bvtE/t8dfjd86) and give feedback on the user experience (Pro tip, set your location to Lekki Phase 1)

Hey everyone! We’re [Ethan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/changethan/) and [Isaac,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isaackan/) and we’re building [Forge](https://www.linkedin.com/company/forgerewards)[.](https://www.forgerewards.com/) Our journey started as roommates at Stanford where we worked on ad-branded contraceptives, AI-generated Spotify playlists, and exploring new restaurants in Palo Alto. Today, we’re on a mission to enhance customer relationships through restaurant loyalty, and have 300+ partners including Chubby Group, Liuyishou Hotpot, and Daeho Dining.

**The Problem**

In high school, Ethan saw firsthand, while helping manage a 3 location Korean corndog shop, that local mom-and-pop restaurants struggle with building digital presence and customer retention; since they fail to acquire and retain repeat customers; while losing 30% to third-party delivery apps and big corporations.

On the other hand, publicly-trading mega-corporations like Starbucks and Domino’s are well equipped with teams of in-house engineers that spend $MM’s every year to  control their customer’s dining journey with their technology.

**Our Solution: Forge, the Starbucks app for your brand.**

Forge brings this sophisticated technology to any restaurant brand, white-labeled at a very low-cost. We want to level the playing field for any restaurant to compete with these conglomerates, so we make premium loyalty apps that include Amex-like status, tiers, points, membership subscriptions, in-app orders, and a whole suite of AI-powered marketing tools.

This has already resulted in stronger customer relationships, new revenue, recurring revenue streams, and increases in both average customer spend and visit frequencies with over $60M in new revenue redirected to our partners, 3x increased visits, and over 500,000 active users across our apps!

name: Certus AI
long_description:
Certus AI is replacing the restaurant phone line with Voice AI.

Restaurants lose up to $100,000 per year per location from missed calls, lost orders, and abandoned hold lines. Staff are overwhelmed. IVRs frustrate customers. Call centers are expensive and impersonal.

It’s 2025. Guests don’t leave voicemails or wait on hold. They just move on.

Certus is an AI voice agent built for restaurants. It answers every call, 24/7 — taking orders, processing deliveries, booking reservations, upselling, and handling complaints in English, Spanish, French and more. Certus is built to manage the phone line end to end, from the customer call to the restaurant tech stack, with zero human intervention required. It currently integrates with industry-leading systems like Toast, Square, Clover, UberEats, DoorDash, and more.

We’re building the voice layer of the modern restaurant — the employee they’ll never fire.

We started Certus because we lived the pain. Gurveer (CEO) grew up answering phones in his family’s restaurant and helped operate them, growing from 1 to 11 locations in 7 years. Later, he and Adam (CRO) ran a restaurant growth startup to help others increase revenue, but kept watching clients bleed cash because no one picked up the phone. So we built the solution the industry always wished existed.

Until now, this problem was considered unsolvable. But Voice AI has finally crossed the conversational chasm and 72% of consumers now prefer AI over humans as long as it means faster and better service.

More importantly, the market is begging for this. The North American restaurant industry crossed $1 trillion in 2024, and it's projected to hit $1.5 trillion in 2025. Yet over $100 billion is still lost annually to missed calls, human error, and outdated tech. As the market continues to grow, so do the losses!

Our customers say it best:

- “Certus changed my life overnight.”
- “We were losing the ability to give great in-house service — the phone was killing us.”
-  “70% of my business comes through the phone. That’s mine and my 16 staffs livelihood.”
- “Before Certus, I used to lose 40 - 60 calls a day…. now my printer just stays printing!”
-  “I’ve been in the business 38 years. I’ve been waiting for this since then.”

Certus is here to fix the $120B phone problem — one call at a time.

And in doing so, we’re redefining how the restaurant industry communicates forever, starting with the phone line.

## TL;DR — Certus AI is an AI voice agent for restaurants. Certus answer every call, take orders, processes deliveries, and books reservations.

---

### ❌ The Problem

Restaurants lose **up to $100,000 per year per location** because of missed calls.

* The average restaurants gets 75 calls/day from customers trying to order, book, or ask a simple question
* 25% of those calls go unanswered on any given day
* Every missed call = lost revenue/ angry customer
* Call centers are expensive. IVRs frustrate customers. Staff is overloaded.

The phone is still one of the most valuable channels in hospitality, yet it costs the industry **$100B+ annually**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92344&key=user_uploads/2362198/84bc1556-5735-4b05-8664-5054b06ba4e7)

---

### ✅ Our Solution

**Certus AI is a multilingual Voice AI agent that answers every call:**

* Takes orders
* Books reservations
* Processes deliveries
* Handles complaints better than humans
* And always upsells, increasing AOV

It answers every call, in real time, and **connects to POS, reservation and delivery systems like:**

* Toast
* Square
* Clover
* UberEats
* DoorDash & more

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92344&key=user_uploads/2362198/78dc0426-c23d-4db3-8144-4427fce04bc7)

---

### 🎯 Why Now

* **72% of consumers** are comfortable speaking to AI if it means faster service
* **LLMs and voice synthesis** have finally crossed the quality threshold for real-world use
* **Labor costs are rising, staff is burning out**, and operators are actively searching for solutions
* The **restaurant industry crossed $1T** in 2024 and it's bleeding $100B/year to missed calls, human error, and outdated workflows

---

### 👋 Who We Are

---

I’m Gurveer, and **I’ve been answering restaurant phones since I was 9.**

My family started with one location and grew to 11. At every stage, the phone _made or broke_ the business: missed calls meant missed orders, staff burnout, and broken operations. That chaos didn’t go away as we scaled.

**In the early days, we couldn’t afford to lose revenue, BUT, we also couldn't afford to hire someone just to manage the phone.** So I became the phone guy. I was so obsessed with not missing calls that **I carried our restaurant hotline with me _everywhere:_** to the gym, school, or even parties. No joke. I’d step out mid-convo to take a catering order.

Later, Adam (CRO) and I ran a growth startup for restaurants. We’d drive serious demand, but the same problem always came back: no one picked up the phone to covert that into revenue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92344&key=user_uploads/2362198/a1a5d359-a692-4803-8a78-357383fcd24d)

That obsession, and frustration, is what led us to build Certus. The phone line is still one of the most valuable, yet broken, parts of a restaurant. **Now, it’s finally being replaced by Certus AI.**

---

> “We were losing the ability to give great in-house service… **the phone was killing us**.”
>
> “**70% of my business comes through the phone. That’s mine and my 16 staffs livelihood.**”

launches.title: Marble: The autonomous back-of-house for restaurants
launches.tagline: Marble uses computer vision and voice AI to count inventory in minutes and a collection of AI agents that run inventory and labor management on autopilot.
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Arjun and Aakar, and we’re launching Marble (previously Truffle), the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house.

**TL;DR:** We help restaurants control their two biggest costs, inventory and labor—saving them thousands of dollars per month in food waste, stockouts, and labor overage. We replace today's patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets and clipboards with a single, easy to use system that actually does the work. We use computer vision and voice AI to count inventory 90% faster than manual counts, ML models to forecast item-level demand with 97% accuracy, and AI agents that run dozens of end-to-end workflows autonomously, including ordering, invoice reconciliation, scheduling, food prep, menu engineering, and more.

**The result**: We're live and scaling rapidly across multi-unit operations in the US and Canada. You can find us today in A&W Restaurants, The Kati Roll Company, Sophie’s Cuban, Kokomo NYC, HolyShred, Dead Letter No. 9 and many more. We’ve driven a 40% reduction in food waste, eliminated stockouts, and saved managers 30+ labor hours per week.

Check us out here:[ www.joinmarble.ai](http://www.joinmarble.ai)

**Our ask:** If you run or know someone who runs a restaurant, café, bar, or hospitality group, we'd love to talk. You can reach us at [founders@joinmarble.com](mailto:founders@joinmarble.com).

**Everyone knows someone who runs a restaurant, bar, or cafe - we’re also giving away $500 (or an Oura Ring) per referral!** [www.joinmarble.com/refer](http://www.joinmarble.com/refer) 

<https://youtu.be/Sbib-QYUH_Y> 

**The Problem**

Restaurant operators face an uphill battle. Ultra-competitive markets, rising food and labor costs, unforgiving hours, and after all of it, they take home 5% in net profit (if they're lucky).

A restaurant can be full all day and night, but it's the back office operations that determine whether that money hits the bottom line. Today that back office still runs on clipboards, spreadsheets, and guesswork. Inventory gets counted by hand, if at all, so no one has a real-time picture of what's actually on the shelf. Orders get placed from memory, so operators either over-buy (contributing to $150B+ in annual food waste) or under-buy and stock out on the exact items guests came for. Food prep and schedules are built on best-effort guesses, and invoices go unchecked while suppliers quietly raise prices line by line.

Every one of these is a margin decision, and every one is being made blind, leading to errors that compound every day, across every location.

**The Solution**

Marble runs the entire back office for restaurants. This centers around managing the two biggest cost centers (inventory and labor) and works in 4 phases:

* **Capture:** Computer vision + voice AI through our mobile app allow operators to count inventory 90% faster than manual counts, with 99% accuracy. No more hours spent counting items in a walk-in freezer with a clipboard (IYKYK). Invoices and deliveries are captured the same way.
* **Forecast:** ML models predict item-level demand for the weeks ahead at 97% accuracy. In addition to that, LLM-powered agents scan the signals a spreadsheet never sees - local events, weather, news, reservations, holidays - and adjust the forecast for what's actually happening around each location.
* **Act:** A set of AI agents run the workflows that actually move the needle on profitability: placing optimized orders, building demand-informed prep sheets, drafting schedules, proactively tracking and flagging waste, reconciling invoices, engineering menus, and more.
* **Learn:** This industry runs on tribal knowledge. We have built the product as a closed-loop system from day one: every count, correction, and order flows back into the platform as context that our agents carry forward, so Marble learns how each location actually runs, adapts to its patterns automatically, and gets sharper every day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108273&key=user_uploads/1278164/1dd8a396-a754-4277-ad3b-1613bf1d4212)

**Team**

We’ve been close friends for nearly 10 years, since our freshman year at Michigan, and we're having a blast taking on this industry.

Aakar grew up managing the back office for his family's multi-unit quick service restaurants, where he saw the problem up close. He later covered the restaurant sector as an investment banker at Goldman Sachs before leaving to lead growth at an applied-AI startup in healthcare.

Arjun is a second-time founder and was previously a Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg, where he led AI/ML initiatives on the Electronic Trading team. At Bloomberg, he built out complex trading systems that processed tens of millions of dollars daily.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108273&key=user_uploads/1278164/2bab9f3a-cca8-4846-8be1-6cf2a4e38dcf)

launches.title: TryNearby: Every local business needs to be discoverable. That $150B market is moving toward local creators.
launches.tagline: Word of mouth at scale for local restaurants
launches.body:
Hey everyone,

We're Yousef, Obaida, and Ahmad, the founders of **TryNearby**.

Yousef co-founded FaZe Clan and spent 15 years creating content for 10M+ followers alongside hundreds of other creators. Ahmad and Obaida co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, building the infrastructure that tracked billions of views across thousands of videos for creator campaigns. We've watched creator content become the most powerful distribution channel on the internet, and we're bringing it to local businesses.

## **TL;DR**

84% of small businesses on TikTok say it helped grow their business. Almost every restaurant owner we meet knows that and has no idea how to act on it.

TryNearby handles it. Every month we send a new group of creators who live nearby to visit, film, and post a review, for a $399 subscription. All of it is handled by us and our AI agents.

Today, 120+ restaurants are subscribed and have had 2,500+ videos posted for them. We nearly doubled one restaurant's revenue in their first month, and owners tell us people walk in every day saying "we saw you on TikTok." Almost half our new restaurants now come from other owners referring us.

Our launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lSG0v1MNwik>

## **The problem**

There are about 1 million restaurants and cafes in the US. Most of them are invisible in the places people actually decide where to eat.

The options an owner has today:

* Agencies cost thousands a month and often don’t drive real results
* Influencers work, but finding the right local ones, negotiating, and doing it again every month is a job by itself
* Creating their own content is a second full-time job they don't have time for, or a full-time hire they don't have the budget for

And here's the thing: _the algorithm doesn't reward a business talking about itself. It rewards people talking about the business._

So the thing that actually works — someone who lives nearby posting about your food — happens once or twice, or not at all.

And the platforms keep rewarding the ones who show up. TikTok's new Local Feed ranks by location and recency, so the restaurants getting fresh content every month reach their own neighborhood. The ones who don't, disappear.

## **The solution**

TryNearby is a subscription that puts local creators inside local restaurants every month, and their followers through the door.

$399/month. Every month we automatically schedule a new group of vetted creators who live nearby. They come in, film, edit, and post. The restaurant just serves the food.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/7721f4f4-96e4-4a68-b860-841fee782765)

### **Part 1 — They sign up, creators start showing up**

The moment a restaurant joins, our matching agent finds the creators nearby who fit that spot and sends the invites. Sometimes a creator is scheduled to visit within five minutes of a restaurant signing up. Creators pick their own time from the restaurant's availability. The restaurant doesn't coordinate anything or answer a single message.

### **Part 2 — An AI agent runs every creator relationship**

Every creator on TryNearby is managed over iMessage by an agent we built. Onboarding, match invites, booking, reminders, reschedules, questions. It handles over 10,000 texts a month.

It also learns as it goes. Every conversation teaches it more about that creator: what they like to eat, where they'll actually drive, when they're free, what they turn down. That context feeds the matching, so the invites get better the longer someone is on the platform.

For creators, it's a personal assistant that helps them become better creators while bringing collaborations straight to their iMessage instead of them chasing restaurants.

### **Part 3 — Restaurant owners get their own AI agent to text**

Owners get an assistant in iMessage too. It watches every video, comment, and review, and tells them what's happening: who's visiting this week, how the last video performed, what people are saying. So when a dish sells out the week after a creator posted about it, the owner knows exactly why.

Our team sits behind both agents. Anything either one can't handle gets flagged to us in seconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/5ff964f8-9013-42d7-9617-29d6ccb2164a)

## **Traction**

10 months in:

* 120+ paying restaurants across Southern California
* 37% month-over-month growth with over 90% monthly restaurant retention since November
* 2,500+ videos posted by local creators → \~35M views, almost entirely from people within a few miles

What that turned into for the restaurants:

* A restaurant in San Diego nearly doubled revenue in a single month
* Another had a whole new demographic of customers drive a 50% increase in sales
* Dishes featured in creator videos hit record sales the following week

Every single owner tells us the same thing: **people are walking in and saying they saw them on TikTok.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/3301e743-2fef-43c4-9138-aaa5631d1eb8)

## **Team**

**Yousef** co-founded FaZe Clan after starting as a 14-year-old YouTuber in 2010. He spent 15 years in the creator economy, built an audience of 10M+ followers and over a billion views, and helped take FaZe public on the Nasdaq at a $1B valuation.

**Ahmad** co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, where he built the first and largest infrastructure for short-form clipping, tracking 10B+ views across tens of thousands of videos for some of the biggest creators on the internet. UC Berkeley CS, previously a senior engineer at WeightWatchers.

**Obaida** co-founded the clipping company alongside Ahmad. He was an early employee at Replit, previously Goldman Sachs, and grew a consumer app from $360K to $2M ARR in 18 months. Master's in applied economics from Johns Hopkins.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/031126b7-4cbd-49dc-989f-ef79381b8bd9)

If you own a restaurant, know an owner who wants more foot traffic, are a local creator, or are just interested in TryNearby, we'd love to talk → 📧 [hello@trynearby.com](https://mailto:hello@trynearby.com)
